errors.text_span: three models: mBERT, XLM-R, and same/better performance
errors.evidence: The chart does not compare three models. It compares two models (implicitly mBERT and XLM-R) and displays the task count for three outcomes: 'mBERT' was better, 'XLM-R' was better, or their performance was the 'same'. Phrasing 'same' as a model is incorrect and misrepresents the chart's purpose.
According to the legend in the image, the light blue bars represent 'mBERT', not 'better' performance. 'better' is the title of the legend, which encompasses all three bar types.

The description claims that the green bars ('same') are taller than the dark blue bars ('XLM-R') only for the IE-Germanic and IE-Romance categories. However, the green bar is also taller for the 'IE-other' category (approx. 8 vs. 6).
